status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Hand-drawn sketch
summary: A thoughtful notebook feel, with deliberately clear information.
use_when: Use for workshop activities, early concepts, and collaborative learning guides.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: Georgia italic headings paired with system sans-serif body.
layout: Notebook spacing, hand-marked accents, and short clear content groups.
surfaces: Slightly irregular outlines, ruled paper, and sketched emphasis.
exclude: Roughness used as a substitute for structure

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Hand-drawn sketch to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Georgia italic headings paired with system sans-serif body. Notebook spacing, hand-marked accents, and short clear content groups. Slightly irregular outlines, ruled paper, and sketched emphasis. Palette: background #faf7e9, surface #fffdf5, text #343d42, muted #58646c, accent #335e7a, border #a6afb1. Essential traits: Hand-marked accents; Notebook rhythm; Readable native text. Avoid: Unreadable script fonts; Excess scribbles; Roughness used as a substitute for structure. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
